full_cart = await run_command("""python -c "
import sqlite3, json
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')

# Get all cart items with product details and variant info
query = '''
SELECT c.customer_id, ci.product_id, p.name, p.price, ci.quantity, ci.gift_wrap,
       pv.variant_label, pv.variant_value, pv.price_override,
       cu.name as customer_name
FROM cart_items ci
JOIN carts c ON ci.cart_id = c.id
JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.id
JOIN customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.id
LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON ci.variant_id = pv.id
ORDER BY c.customer_id, ci.id
'''
rows = conn.execute(query).fetchall()
for r in rows:
    cust_id, prod_id, prod_name, price, qty, gift_wrap, var_label, var_value, price_override, cust_name = r
    effective_price = price_override if price_override else price
    line_total = effective_price * qty
    variant_str = f' ({var_label}: {var_value})' if var_label else ''
    gw = ' [Gift Wrap]' if gift_wrap else ''
    print(f'Customer {cust_id} ({cust_name}): {prod_name}{variant_str} | Qty: {qty} | \${effective_price:.2f} ea | Line: \${line_total:.2f}{gw}')
"
""")
print(full_cart)
